title: Apple iPhone 17 256GB Lavender $1250 @ Skytree Phones
body:
Deal: Apple iPhone 17 256GB Lavender $1250 @ Skytree Phones

[thriver] Can I know where and how did you got the pricebeat? It was rejected for me by the customer care over phone, stating skytree is not legit
[ozioziozi] To price match Skytree you will need to go to a store in person and not all stores price match Skytree so you may have to try a few.
[Blacklite] Melbourne Bourke St.
My backup plan was to get them to price match DigiDirect that has any colour for $1347… so could get OW to price match that down to $1279… I don't think they can argue that DigiDirect isn't a real store.
[Spector1] Don't know if anyone else noticed but they've increase the price to $1549 from $1399 since yesterday.
[Kanjus] Yes. $150 hike on all existing models thanks to memory and chip prices
[Kanjus] Ow would not price match as soon as i mentioned skytree. Ymmv
[Brick50] JB wouldn't price match them last week as they were not Apple Authorised reseller
[crentist] So if Officeworks doesn't price match (tried a few stores) the next question is whether Skytree is legit?
If they are the cheapest place to buy an iPhone, should we just buy from them?
Previous deals focus more on the price matching than the actual store. Experiences are few and polarised. Some people get a nice new phone, and some say they are actually grey/used and that an abusive owner coerced held refunds hostage until they had left a good review
[He-Mania] Red flags for me are Gmail contact addresses and mobile phone numbers as business contacts.
Asking their AI chatbot - it does state the phones are not grey imports - I guess it's up to the consumer to trust or not.
Ps
I got my local OW to price beat
[Jack Ma] Was able to price match OW Canning Vale, WA
[El cheepo] I am yet to be denied price matching questionable websites at any officeworks in WA.
I dunno if its a just a lucky run or what, but i ain’t complaining 😂
[Lucatony] First OW wouldn't price beat the white one at OW Southland - also they didn't have stock even though their website says they so, drove to OW Mentone and they price beat it no problem at all. Purchased the white version for $1239 or so, one left in stock.
[Crossking] I went to Bayswater officework. They rejected
[Zenyth] I was able to price match the last iPhone 17 256GB Lavender in stock at Officeworks Campbellfield, thank you OP 🙌🏽
[EWing1389] Was able to price match at OW Waurn Ponds, none in store but delivery scheduled on Monday, paid $1187.5, thanks!
[TheGreenMachine] No luck at OW Northmead or Auburn today.
[Kalki] Grabbed one, thanks OP. Lavender now OOS.
[RandomDealHunter] Had a chat with Manager at my OW and he mentioned that they won’t price match Skytree. They have received notice from head office to not price match as Skytree’s ABN is related to a person and not to a business (which is incorrect), Contact Details are a bit suss and they are not stocking Aus stock.
When I showed him the ABN and that they are stocking Australian Stock, he apologised and said he really can’t after the influx of iPhone Pro Max price matches last week! They have now been directed by the head office but if they get an updated advice, they will start price matching again.
He sounded pretty genuine tbh.
[hawkeye93] ACCC then misleading and deceptive conduct. Price beat guarantee and not doing it is ridiculous.
